description:
More than a billion people trust Photos with their most important memories. The Photos QA team keeps that experience reliable, fast, and polished across every Apple platform and iCloud. Every release depends on detailed, judgment-heavy work, triaging bugs, assessing risk, planning coverage, and qualifying builds. We’re looking for a software engineer to build the tools and agentic AI systems for quality engineering that make that work faster and more consistent, without sacrificing accuracy.

Description
This role focuses on designing, building, and integrating the tools that support the Photos QA team's work across automation, triage, test planning, and release qualification. You will balance hands-on engineering with close collaboration, working alongside QA and software engineers to understand their workflows and prioritize what to build. Once a tool is in use, you will help the team adopt it and keep improving it based on their feedback.

Responsibilities
Partner with Photos development engineering, quality integrity and engineering, and program management to identify where better tooling will have the most impact
Design, build, and maintain tools, dashboards, and workflows, including AI-powered ones, that support automation triage, test plan generation, coverage gap analysis, and build qualification
Design and build agentic AI systems that reason across multiple tools and data sources, such as bug tracking, build pipelines, and test management systems, to complete multi-step QA tasks with minimal human intervention
Design and implement tools that navigate complex, multi-platform architecture flows across iOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, and iCloud backend services, with visibility into cross-platform dependencies and failure modes
 Connect large local or external models to bug tracking systems, sw build pipelines, and test management systems using structured tool calling, MCP/plugins, and scheduled or event-driven workflows
 Build evaluation harnesses, golden datasets, and regression suites that measure the accuracy and consistency of AI-generated output and flag failures clearly
Build tools that set photo libraries on test devices to known, reproducible states and capture diagnostics such as memory graphs and logs
Integrate automation and AI tools into CI/CD pipelines, nightly runs, and release qualification
Document and package tools as reusable workflows, and train QA engineers to adopt them


Minimum qualifications
Industry experience in software development, test automation, or tools engineering
Proficiency in Swift or Python, with a track record of building tools and frameworks used by others
Experience using AI/LLMs to improve your own workflow or build AI-assisted tooling, with the ability to critically review and debug AI-generated output
Strong understanding of quality engineering: test design, coverage strategy, flakiness reduction, root-cause analysis
Experience integrating tools and automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience


Preferred qualifications
Proficiency in both Swift and Python
Experience with multi-agent systems or orchestrating complex AI workflows with tool-using capabilities
Understanding of distributed systems and multi-platform architecture testing
Experience designing evaluations for AI systems
Experience with scheduled or event-driven automation, such as cron jobs or webhooks
Experience with UI automation using XCTest or XCUITest
Experience driving adoption of new tools across a team or organization
Demonstrated ability to manage your own priorities and drive projects with minimal direction
Familiarity with the Photos app and Apple’s media ecosystem
